purpose: SECOND-CHANNEL CENSUS (T056's registered e106, QUEUE slot): name the read's second channel. Rebuild e100/e104's battery, decision points, features and V-zero ground truth bit-identically (G5 vs e084/e100/e104), then at the FAILING stratum (e104's powered bottom-decile band) vs SUCCEEDING: (a) L3-only attention mass, (b) L3H0-H3 per-head masses, (c) DELTA (L3 minus L1L2, raw + balanced), (d) margin-quartile-resolved early-vs-late pooled AUC crossing curve. FROZEN BARS: TWO-CHANNEL iff at failing max(L3, L3H*) >= 0.75 while L1L2 < 0.6 with CI separation (names the late channel); SINGLE-CHANNEL iff |L3 - L1L2| <= 0.05 in ALL strata (residual unexplained; next probe registered); else MIXED.

failing_band.rule: bottom decile of valid DPs by full-16 attention-mass AUC (e104 verbatim)

features.early: L1+L2 attention mass (8 heads summed) — the comparator (e104's L1/L2-mass)
features.full16: sum of all 16 layer-heads (e100's primary; reference)
features.delta: (c) L3 mass - L1L2 mass per entry; raw primary, per-head-balanced (m_L3/4 - m_L1L2/8) sensitivity

protocol.ground_truth: V-zero flip at the e084 bars (v := 0 at the entry's position, every layer, every head, all queries; argmax flip vs the same call's clean row)
protocol.auc: Mann-Whitney tie-averaged; pooled = pair-weighted across decision points (pairs only within a decision); bootstrap CI = decision-point resampling within stratum n=1000; paired-diff CI resamples DPs jointly

margin_crossing.definition: late > early at Q0 AND early > late at Q3 (point estimates); strong = paired-diff CIs exclude 0 with opposite signs

frozen_bars.two_channel: at failing stratum: max(AUC_L3, AUC_L3H*) >= 0.75 AND AUC_L1L2 < 0.6 AND late CI lo > early CI hi => EARLY ROUTING + LATE CORRECTION (head named)
frozen_bars.single_channel: |AUC_L3 - AUC_L1L2| <= 0.05 in all strata ['failing', 'succeeding', 'Q0', 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3'] => residual stays unexplained; next probe registered honestly

registered_decision.verdict: MIXED: the two-channel bar did not fire (early AUC 0.779 not < 0.6) and late does NOT track early everywhere (deviating strata: ['succeeding', 'Q0', 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3']) — an honest intermediate; neither registered reading holds cleanly.
